name: SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)
launch_requirements_note: DETECT-ONLY semantics (approved 2026-11-14): this template is REFERENCE metadata used to CHECK that the user's Steam launch options already point at SMAPI. The plugin NEVER writes/sets launch options, NEVER installs SMAPI, NEVER applies a DLL override, NEVER touches a Proton prefix. Missing launcher -> E_LOADER_MISSING (an error, not an install).

external_manager.note: Flatpak io.github.Amethyst.ModManager deploys Mods/ via symlinks + Mods_Core/. When detected the plugin refuses every write (status/list_inbox/inspect remain available). Never move/rewrite symlinks or Mods_Core/.

notes: SMAPI mods are directories with manifest.json in Mods/. Note the collision with RimWorld's Mods/ folder name - each descriptor resolves its OWN mod_root, never a shared global. This loader entry is ACTIVE as DETECT-ONLY metadata for the stardew descriptor; it is not an installer.
